description: Native parser declaration initializer overload compatibility for detection scripts. Synthetic pointer types use the actual ScriptBind default registrations, including typed tags. Valid pointer/text/scalar/tag declarations and invalid cross-type or readonly-to-editable initializers are compiled and valid cases executed. Audit cases cover pointers to primitive, tag and Position values, including absent initializers. Position storage is synthetic; native raw value registration and BindValue templates execute unchanged. Native explicit pointer/editable-pointer/tag null assignment and Mod null repair are captured as well.

buildOptions.sources: Script.cpp::parseVariable/parseVariableImpl/parseOverloadProc; ScriptBind.h::Bind/ArgSelector/BindSet; Script.h::ArgCompatible; Tile.cpp::ScriptRegister raw Position value and BindValue registration
buildOptions.compiler: MSVC x64 /std:c++20; full native Script.cpp and Yaml.cpp
